allow.reason: Recorded exception, not a migration: the browser agent's completion chain is provided by the gateway's LLM surface over HTTP, and sdkwork-llm has no in-process provider yet (its LanguageModelPort has zero implementations; the architecture doc schedules provider adapters for Phase 2). So this is the default transport, not the anti-pattern the rule targets: the opt-in is inverted, in-process is the explicit SDKWORK_BROWSER_AGENT_LLM_MODE=in_process path that needs a host-injected provider, and the endpoint read lives only in this explicitly named http adapter module, validated at startup when LLM inference is enabled. Re-evaluate this entry when sdkwork-llm ships a completion provider.
